# 🎃 THE BINDING OF ISAAC: REBIRTH — ONLINE SETUP

**SteaMidra + REPENTOGON · Isaac Profile Manager · OnlineFix**

> Full walkthrough for modded online co-op with friends — shared mod profile included so nobody desyncs.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 1️⃣ Download the Game
1. In **SteaMidra**, download **The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth**.
2. Once it's downloaded, select the game from the dropdown in the **Home** tab and click **DLC Check**.
3. Select **all** DLC checkboxes, then click **Download** (with **MidraEveryday**).

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 2️⃣ Install the REPENTOGON Launcher
1. Grab the latest zip → **[REPENTOGON Releases](https://github.com/TeamREPENTOGON/Launcher/releases)**
2. Put the zip inside the **game's root folder** (same folder as the Isaac `.exe`).
3. Extract it there using **Extract to `REPENTOGONLauncher\`** (extract-to-subfolder / `/*`), so you end up with a `REPENTOGONLauncher` folder inside the game root.
4. Launch the game through the launcher in that folder to confirm REPENTOGON boots correctly before continuing.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 3️⃣ Install Isaac Profile Manager
-# Replaces the old Isaac Profiles + IsaacSync tools — both are deprecated now.
1. Grab the latest release → **[Isaac Profile Manager](https://github.com/XevioQwerty/Isaac-Profile-Manager/releases)**
2. Run the setup.
3. Import the shared mod profile below — this gives you the exact same mod list as everyone else, which is the #1 fix for random desyncs.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 4️⃣ Patch for Online Modded Co-op
Vanilla online co-op force-disables mods — this patches the binary so they stay active.
1. Grab it → **[Isaac-Online-Modded](https://github.com/xADDBx/Isaac-Online-Modded)**
2. Run it against your game binary as described in its README.
-# Re-patch after every game or mod update — it doesn't survive a fresh binary.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 🚀 Play
Launch through the REPENTOGON launcher, invite your friends, and get in. Re-import the shared mod profile in Isaac Profile Manager before every session to stay in sync with the group.
